Introduction section:introduction Warehouse automation depends on knowing where every person and every piece of equipment is, in metric floor coordinates, at every instant. A single camera cannot provide this information: it recovers a bearing but not a range, and, among tall racks, a target may disappear behind an obstruction within a few frames. Fixed multi-camera rigs with overlapping fields of view are the standard remedy, and the task they define is multi-target multi-camera (MTMC) 3D perception: recovering each object's world-frame position, footprint, and orientation, together with an identity that persists through occlusions and handovers between cameras~ tang_9th_2025 . The obstacle is supervision. Dense 3D boxes and cross-camera identities are expensive to annotate at scale in a working facility~ woo_mtmmc_2024 , so the practical solution has been to train in simulation, where exact ground truth is freely available. What simulation does not capture is the collection of small physical irregularities that accumulate in a real installation: a lens that does not conform to the calibration on file, an object whose true dimensions differ from those in the catalogue, and a floor whose occupancy has not been counted. We present Syn2RealTrack, our AI City Challenge 2026 Track~1 system: an online multi-camera 3D perception pipeline trained mainly on synthetic data and evaluated partly on real scenes~ Tang26AICity26 ; illustrates the two domains and our point-cloud-guided box refinement on both. Rather than treating the synthetic-to-real gap as one domain-adaptation problem, we localize it to three interfaces (camera calibration, object-shape priors, and known object counts) and address each where it arises. summarizes the framework; our contributions are as follows. Localizing the synthetic-to-real gap. With feature extractors trained once and then frozen across domains, we expose calibration, camera overlap, and object counts as a configuration surface that shifts trust from simulation-specific geometry to appearance when these cues are unreliable in real scenes ( ). Distortion-aware camera grouping. As the calibration omits lens distortion, we estimate it with AnyCalib~ tirado-garin_anycalib_2025 , split reference and fisheye views by the Unified Camera Model parameter , undistort footpoints while keeping the provided geometry, and mask fisheye-only zones to avoid invalid matches. Cross-view fusion that can abstain. We ground detections, fuse views by visibility-weighted part similarity, and propagate single-camera identities before geometric assignment to reject inconsistent world placements; this fusion adds HOTA on top of single-view association. Measured rather than synthetic geometry. For people, a closed-form estimate from calibration and ankle ground points replaces the synthetic height prior without depth or extra supervision; an RGB-only Depth Anything~3 (DA3) point cloud~ lin2026depth then refines footprint and yaw while preserving identity and class-specific size. A contained closed-world prior. We apply exact per-class counts only in suitable closed-world scenes and suppress unsupported boxes with a causal filter requiring visible-ankle confirmation after reprojection into covering cameras; this filter yields a detection-driven gain at negligible association cost. Related Work section:related_works -to-Real Generalization and Calibration. Multi-camera domain shift is both photometric and geometric. Prior work improves transfer through view-consistent augmentation, depth- and pose-robust BEV features, or perspective-invariant rendering~ engilberge_augmentation_2023,wang_dg_bev_2023,lu_perspective_rendering_2025,huynh_tsbow_2026 ; calibration methods instead recover camera geometry from person correspondences, learned perspective cues, or predicted pixel rays~ xu_widebaseline_calibration_2021,veicht2024geocalib,tirado-garin_anycalib_2025,tran_region-and-trajectory_2021 . Our pipeline keeps its feature extractors and the provided intrinsics and extrinsics fixed; it adapts only at explicit downstream interfaces and estimates each camera's omitted lens distortion before ground-plane projection. , Visibility, and Multi-View Association. Prior work localizes people and recovers metric shape through calibrated pose, projective metrology, RGB geometry, or point-supported box refinement~ lima_generalizable_2021,criminisi_single_2000,wang_vggt_2025,ma_dchm_2025,lin2026depth,shi_pointrcnn_2019 . Association methods use visible-part features~ somers_bpbreid_2023,DBLP:conf/eccv/SomersAV24 , probabilistic occupancy, target-count, and camera models~ vo_cphd_2007,ong_bayesian_2022,pham_data_2025 , or learned BEV and trajectory relationships~ teepe_earlybird_2024,wang_mcblt_2025,yamane_mvtrajecter_2025 . Our causal pipeline combines these ideas: class-specific anchors and ankle keypoints recover ground contact and person height; RGB point clouds refine footprint and yaw; shared visible parts, local-identity memory, motion, and a bounded gallery guide sequential association. An external class census conditions assignment when available; otherwise, adaptive tracking and a camera-coverage check suppress unsupported person boxes. The key difference from these works is that our association can abstain: parts occluded in either view are excluded from similarity instead of imputed, and single-camera identities take precedence over geometric matching. -View Fusion and Tracking. Multi-view detectors aggregate projected features in BEV using convolution, transformers, or multi-height homographies, while CaMuViD exchanges features directly across uncalibrated views~ hou_mvdet_2020,hou_mvdetr_2021,song_shot_2021,daryani_camuvid_2025,tran_robust_2022 . AI City 2025 systems similarly combine global point-cloud detection, cluster-to-tracklet mapping, or late multi-view tracking and refinement~ tang_9th_2025,lee_pointcloud_reid_2025,tran_depthtrack_2025,phan_vgcrtrack_2025 , but rely on benchmark-provided depth and calibration. The 2026 protocol adds real scenes and withholds depth at inference~ Tang26AICity26 . Our pipeline therefore preserves modular per-view perception and fuses sparse object observations late rather than learning dense BEV aggregation. AI.tldr: Syn2RealTrack 针对多相机室内仓储 3D 跟踪中的合成-真实域差，提出将域差分解为相机校准、物体形状先验与目标数量假设三个可分离接口，并通过几何与外观的局部信任重分配实现无需重训练特征的在线适应，在 AI City Challenge 2026 Track 1 上取得 3D HOTA 52.0118%。
AI.motivation:
1. 现有方法将合成-真实差距视为单一域适应模块的整体问题，忽略了其在不同推理接口的独立诱发机制。
2. 多相机系统训练数据多为合成，真实部署面临无径向畸变系数、物体真实尺寸与合成先验不符、目标数未知等问题，损害地平面定位与跨视角身份关联。
3. 在线跟踪依赖于稳定的检测与 ReID，但现有融合策略对遮挡部件进行猜测引入噪声，且缺乏对异常框的系统性过滤机制。
4. 当真实场景包含未在合成集中出现的类别时，检测器与跟踪器缺乏有效的类别形状迁移与目标数量约束机制。
AI.method:
1. 核心思路：将合成-真实差距解耦至相机校准、物体形状先验、已知目标数三处，分别以局部几何修复、基于可见性的部件描述符、因果滤波封闭世界先验进行修复，整体保持特征提取器冻结。
2. 提出可见性加权部件描述符，仅对未被遮挡的部件计算相似度，放弃猜测遮挡部件信息，避免错误的跨视图融合与身份关联。
3. 利用 AnyCalib 恢复缺失的镜头畸变系数并按 UCM 参数划分鱼眼相机群组，在保持原始针孔几何作为参考的前提下，仅修正投影失真导致的 BEV 偏移。
4. 以坐标闭式估计人体高度替代合成先验，结合 Depth Anything 生成的点云细化足迹与航向角，不依赖深度监督但提升地平面定位精度。
5. 引入因果跟踪滤波器，对封闭世界场景下基于类别计数的先验产生出的赝框进行后验剔除，要求其在覆盖视角中具备可被显著检测的可见脚踝确认。
AI.result: 在 AI City Challenge 2026 Track 1 评估服务器上验证，任务为真实仓储环境下在线多视角多目标 3D 跟踪，涵盖人员与多类工业车辆，包含真实场景部分评测，系统在不重训特征提取器的情况下取得 3D HOTA 52.0118%。
AI.conclusion:
1. 将合成-真实差距结构化成三个独立接口并分配局部修复机制，是降低在线多相机跟踪系统域适应成本的有效路径，证明无需端到端重训练即可获取显著提升。
2. 关键前提是真实场景需满足近似封闭世界假设（类别与目标数受限）以支撑因果滤波器，且依赖预置的相机 intrinsics/extrinsics 与提供的单应性矩阵作为几何锚点。
3. 增益来源被清晰隔离为畸变修正、可 abstain 的融合机制、几何高度估计与封闭世界滤波四部分，但模块间可能存在的间接影响（如点云细化对关联的隐式贡献）未在文中充分量化说明。
4. 系统上限受限于合成训练集的类别覆盖与相机标定精度，对完全开放世界、目标标签突变或严重透视遮挡场景的泛化能力未得到验证。
